title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Club Earning and Corporate Programme Attributes
content:
Three published attributes on the Car Rental Rate Classes govern how a rental stands toward the Wanderlane Traveller Club and toward a corporate travel programme.

| Rate class | Club points earn rate (percent of rental total) | Class upgrade permitted | Corporate programme rate permitted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 0 | no | no |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 50 | no | no |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 75 | yes | yes |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 100 | yes | yes |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 125 | yes | no |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 0 | no | yes |

The earn rate is the percentage of the rental total that accrues as traveller club points. The upgrade column records whether a club tier may obtain a vehicle class upgrade on the class booked. The corporate column records whether a corporate travel programme rate may be applied to the class.

**Points of judgement.** The earn rate rises with the class from 0 on the Pay Now Saver Rate through 50, 75 and 100 to 125 on the Premium Inclusive Rate, and stands at 0 on the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate. A class upgrade is permitted on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate, the Inclusive Flex Rate and the Premium Inclusive Rate, and not on the two Pay Now classes or the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate. A corporate programme rate is permitted on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate, the Inclusive Flex Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate, and not on the two Pay Now classes or the Premium Inclusive Rate.
